import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # I am currently on the General Settings page. Navigate to the Members page using relative goto.
    await page.goto("/byteblaze/a11y-syntax-highlighting/-/project_members")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for page to load
    
    # On the Members page, find and click the 'Invite members' button
    invite_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite members")
    await invite_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Fill in the username or email field with Jakub Klinkovský
    username_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Username or email")
    await username_input.fill("Jakub Klinkovský")
    
    # Select the 'Guest' role from the dropdown
    role_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role")
    await role_dropdown.select_option("Guest")
    
    # Click the 'Invite' button to send the invitation
    send_invite_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite")
    await send_invite_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # After inviting, the task is complete. No further actions needed.
    pass
